===Objectives===
*Journey with Zhed Shadowhoof to the [[Ancestor Tree]] in [[Turai's Procession]].
*See [[Mirza Veldrunner]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*2,500 [[Experience]]
*200 [[Gold]]
*[[Kournan Coin]]

===Environmental changes===
*After accepting the reward and until the completion of the following quest (Mirza's Last Stand), the [[Wandering Priest]] at the [[Resurrection Shrine]] nearest Mirza (that gives the [[Monster Hunt]] bounty) will not [[spawn]] and the [[Melandru's Watcher]] will also not spawn when kneeling at that Resurrection Shrine.

==Walkthrough==
[[Map travel]] to [[Venta Cemetery (outpost)|Venta Cemetery]]. Continue to [[Turai's Procession]] and speak with Mirza.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zhed Shadowhoof
:''"We fight the same war, two-legs, against the hated Warmarshal.  But I have received word that my people need me and any allies I can gather.  You have proved yourself more trustworthy than most humans, so I ask for your aid.  Will you '''accompany me''' to the Ancestor Tree in '''Turai's Procession'''?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = You will not travel alone, Zhed Shadowhoof. Let us help you.
|decline = Alas, we have more pressing matters.
|ask = The Ancestor Tree is in '''Turai's Procession'''. Let us make haste. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Mirza Veldrunner
:''"So you've come to aid the Centaur prides, eh?  Well, don't expect too much in return.  The [[Kournan]]s destroyed most of what we had, leaving us little more than the hides on our backs.  Even now, Kournan troops plan an attack against us.  I await word from my scouts.... So, if you wish to prove yourself to my people, human, that time may come soon."''
